confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on a few Okinawa-specific menu listings and general izakaya and cafe guides, some of them dated, so they are rough. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July peak-season window, not checks of live listings. The FX observation is the 20 March 2026 RBA figure, the most recent official RBA value I could attribute. I could not confirm a newer official RBA observation, and a third-party site republishing the RBA table showed 0.703 for 31 July 2026, which I did not use because it is not from rba.gov.au. Yen-to-USD conversions assume roughly 150 JPY per USD.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Okinawa-prefecture and mainland Japanese regional-city pricing for cafes, izakaya beer, cocktail bars and budget set meals, with accommodation scaled to Naha's summer tourism demand.
